fusions.name: Bounding Kick
fusions.desc: A bounding kick at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Rutting Clash
fusions.desc: A clash of horn on horn that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Startled Scatter
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Turn at Bay
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
